name: Kentucky
overview: The principal statewide residential relief identified is an assessed-value homestead exemption for older or totally disabled owners.

programs.name: Homestead Exemption
programs.ageRule: Age 65+ during the tax period, or qualifying total disability.
programs.maximumBenefit: $49,100 reduction in assessed value for 2025 and 2026; this is not a $49,100 tax credit.
programs.formulaSummary: Deduct the statutory exempt value from eligible assessed value, then apply property-tax rates.
programs.application: Application and proof to the county Property Valuation Administrator by December 31 of the eligible year.
eligibilityNotes: Own, occupy and maintain the property as a personal residence on January 1.

researchNotes: No statewide renter credit or refundable property-tax circuit breaker was identified in the reviewed DOR materials.
Exemption tax savings require applicable tax rates and are contextual to the credit comparison.
